title: Bad instructions, worse quality of materials. Too flimsy to support its own weight plus dust!
text:
Bad instructions, worse quality of materials. Too flimsy to support its own weight plus dust!. After putting this together, I want to bang my head on the desk in sheer frustration..... except I am actually afraid the entire thing will just collapse from the vibration. Honestly, the only way this could be more flimsy and more useless is if it were made of actual cardboard held together with pre-chewed bubble gum.

The problems begin at the beginning - the instructions are ridiculous. Dependent on terms like "Attach bracket A to Board A" and Insert Screw 3 into holes on Leg Support Left and Leg Support Front" and so on. You look at the parts and slowly realize that none of them are actually labeled and all 66 screws (four different sizes!) plus the 9 brackets are loose in one big plastic bag. None of that chaos is labeled either. Time to study each sketch of each part and match it with the one your hand and write the number/letter on it yourself. See my photos.

Construction is a joke that made me want to just set it on fire half way through. Turns out that not every piece is cut to the correct size. Some are off by a 1/4 inch - including my drawer. It was too wide for the sliding brackets and cracked. I finished without it entirely. The pre-drilled holes do not always line up quite where they should. This means that some screws get stuck in places that are too short or have to be put in on an angle.

I had hoped to use this a console table to hold a pair of decorative lamps behind one of the sofas - no one would ever see it and we would have a little extra light. However, it is so flimsy that I refuse to risk an expensive lamp on it. Do not buy this.
